name: Pet Boarding and Daycare Operations
audience: independent pet boarding facilities and dog daycare operators
topic: record readiness and pickup handoffs for pet boarding teams

products.name: Vaccination Record Chaser
products.product: A focused pet boarding vaccination record tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent pet boarding facilities and dog daycare operators
products.problem: Bookings reach check-in with missing, unreadable, expired, or unreviewed vaccination documents because upload status and facility approval are treated as the same event.
products.valueProposition: Turns pet boarding vaccination record tracking into a visible operating queue so every scheduled pet has verified facility-required records or a documented booking decision before arrival.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets pet boarding vaccination tracker, kennel vaccine records, dog daycare document reminder, and boarding record approval searches.

products.name: Boarding Pickup Handoff
products.product: A focused pet boarding pickup readiness workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent pet boarding facilities and dog daycare operators
products.problem: Pickup becomes a front-desk scramble when authorized collector, belongings, add-on services, stay notes, balance, and pet location are split across cards and messages.
products.valueProposition: Turns pet boarding pickup readiness into a visible operating queue so every departing pet is released to an authorized person with belongings, balance, and approved stay handoff reconciled.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets pet boarding pickup checklist, kennel checkout workflow, dog daycare handoff, and boarding belongings tracker searches.
